patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Husband) All of a sudden the left side of her face drooped, her left arm went weak, and her words got slurred. It started exactly 40 minutes ago while we were eating.
presentation.triageNote: 70-year-old female with sudden left facial droop, left arm weakness, and slurred speech witnessed by her husband during a meal. She was last normal 40 minutes ago; blood pressure is 182/100.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because sudden focal neurologic deficits with a known onset 40 minutes ago are a time-sensitive high-risk stroke presentation.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has acute left facial and arm weakness with slurred speech and a precisely witnessed recent onset.
clinical.acuityReason: The deficit is disabling and within a treatment window; rapid imaging and reperfusion assessment are required despite preserved airway and perfusion.
expectedResources: Immediate bedside glucose and stroke assessment
Non-contrast head CT and vascular imaging
redFlags: Acute focal neurologic deficit within a treatment window
teachingPoints: Exact last-known-well time is critical for reperfusion decisions.
Glucose must be checked because hypoglycemia can mimic stroke.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate imaging and neurologic evaluation would guide thrombolysis, thrombectomy, blood-pressure management, and monitored admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one side of the face drooping, left arm limp in her lap
signs: left arm limp in the lap
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 70-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated with the left side of her face drooping and her left arm resting limp in her lap. Expression: frightened, with an uneven, drooping face. Clearly visible: a one-sided facial droop and a limp left arm. No text, no logos.
